title: Villager Wake
description: Raiding villages is a crime. Iron golems and guard villagers will engage when blocks are broken or chests opened nearby.
body:
<details>
<summary>TL;DR</summary>


<details><summary>Thief</summary>
This is the village protecting mod. It lets your reputation drop down to a point where golems and the villager watch will attack. It is configured "sharp" meaning that the villagers consider everything they see is theirs. If you brake your bed which you placed on the market place and slept in then this is a crime. They do not care that you were the one to place it. You were the one who broke it!
</details>

<details>
<summary>Create</summary>
The Create Fly projects ports the original Create mod to new Minecraft versions. With Create: Nerfad many recipes are added. For example, you can make diamonds from coal blocks. 
  
Coal blocks can be made using this production chain:

- tree farm delivers logs
- logs are blasted to charcoal
- charcoal gets haunted to coal
- coal gets packed to coal blocks
- coal blocks get packed to diamons (50% chance, lava source needed)
</details>


<details>
<summary>Mass hoarding</summary>
With Tom's Simple Storage Mod, Refined Storage, Compact Storage and Storage Delight bulk storing of mass produced items is no problem at all. Accessing the stores from anywhere is possible, too.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Quality of Life</summary>
The mod "Starter Kit" provides you with a wooden sword, a bed, a waystone and some bread. A mini map and world map tell you where you are. Multiple backpack mods help store your findings until you put them into the base. With the uncrafting table you recycle unwanted items. You can "see" on the screen where the zombie is with the on-screen-indicated-audio-sources. Collecting everlasting abilities is a minigame where you can pimp your avatar. Trading three ability totems for a new one in the crafting table may give you the ability you search for. Putting on a full set of obsidian armor gives fire ressitance.
</details>


<details>
<summary>Growing Resources</summary>
If you do not want to generate everything with Create then there is a solution:
Make resource trees. The cow tree is just insane for starting as well as the coal tree.
</details>


<details>
  <summary>Despawn time for items is shortened</summary>
  With Create tree farms and ResourcesTrees throwing leaves all the time there is a heavy load of items like sticks and saplings. This could lead to freezing the game totally. In fact, this happened before I added the mod "Configurable Despawn Timer". 

The config of the  Configurable Despawn Timer is by default as follows:

- Global Item Despawn Time In Ticks : 400 (20 Seconds)
- Global Experience Orb Despawn Time in Ticks: 800 (40 Seconds)
- Prevent Despawn for Player Items: YES

The last point gives the player still the ability to lag the server. But this has to happen on purpose. The in-game-delivered-drops from machines and farms will be deleted before lag arises.

</details>



</details>

There are so many ways to get your stuff: You do not need to raid your villager friends. With resource trees and Create you can grow or craft every needed resource by yourself. Villagers believe that the whole world is theirs. You have to break blocks far enough away from them to be save from losing reputation.

Basic, Tom's and Refined Storage help hoarding stuff. 

With Everlasting Abilities and functional trims you eventually will become a fire resistant bird.

Highly optimized for shaders. Shaders and resource packs included. 
Many quality of life mods.
